annotation.notes: Q: 'When is an AI system classified as high-risk?' Two classification gates are required: OBL-ART6-1 (safety component of Annex I product + third-party conformity assessment) and OBL-ART6-2 (Annex III systems). Both CONDITIONAL_ON risk:high. OBL-ART6-3 (provider self-assessment that an Annex III system is not high-risk) and 6-4 (registration duty that follows) are supporting — related procedure, not the core definition. OBL-ART6-5..8 excluded: they concern Commission delegated acts / guidelines (role []), out of scope for a classification question — NOT excluded to improve scores.
